General Research Use - This data use permission indicates that use is allowed for general research use for any research purpose.
Project Specific Restriction - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to use within an approved project.

Geographical Restriction - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to genetic studies only (i.e., studies that include genotype research alone or both genotype and phenotype research, but not phenotype research exclusively)
Return to Database or Resource - This data use modifier indicates that the requestor must return derived/enriched data to the database/resource.
Clinical Care Use - This data use modifier indicates that use is allowed for clinical use and care.
No General Methods Research - This data use modifier indicates that use does not allow methods development research (e.g., development of software or algorithms).
No Restriction - This data use permission indicates there is no restriction on use.
Not-for-Profit Organisation Use Only - This data use modifier indicates that use of the data is limited to not-for-profit organizations.
Data use modifiers indicate additional conditions for use.
Population Origins or Ancestry Research Only - This data use permission indicates that use of the data is limited to the study of population origins or ancestry.
Non-Commercial Use Only - This data use modifier indicates that use of the data is limited to not-for-profit use.
Not-for-Profit, Non-Commercial Use Only - This data use modifier indicates that use of the data is limited to not-for-profit organizations and not-for-profit use, non-commercial use.
Population Origins or Ancestry Research Prohibited - This data use modifier indicates use for purposes of population, origin, or ancestry research is prohibited.
Ethics Approval Required - This data use modifier indicates that the requestor must provide documentation of local IRB/ERB approval.
Health or Medical or Biomedical Research - This data use permission indicates that use is allowed for health/medical/biomedical purposes; does not include the study of population origins or ancestry.
Publication Required - This data use modifier indicates that requestor agrees to make results of studies using the data available to the larger scientific community.
User Specific Restriction - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to use by approved users. If providing this term, please describe the restrictions in column userSpecificRestriction.

Collaboration Required - This data use modifier indicates that the requestor must agree to collaboration with the primary study investigator(s). If providing this term, please note the contact email in column collaborationRequired.

Research Specific Restrictions - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to studies of a certain research type. If providing this term, please note the research type(s) in column researchSpecificRestrictions.
Time Limit on Use - This data use modifier indicates that use is approved for a specific number of months. If providing this term, please provide the number of months in column timeLimitOnUse.

Publication Moratorium - This data use modifier indicates that requestor agrees not to publish results of studies until a specific date. If providing this term, please provide the date in column publicationMoratorium.

Institution Specific Restriction - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to use within an approved institution. If providing this term, please provide the institution ROR ID(s) in column institutionSpecificRestriction.

Geographical Restriction - This data use modifier indicates that use is limited to within a specific geographic region. If providing this term, please provide the applicable country code(s) in column geographicalRestriction.

Disease Specific Research - This data use permission indicates that use is allowed provided it is related to the specified disease. If providing this term, please provide the disease MONDO ID(s) in column diseaseSpecificResearch.
